mapper.update: UPDATE monthly_ticket_account SET available_balance = available_balance + #{amount}, lifetime_granted = lifetime_granted + #{amount}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{accountId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, source_type AS sourceType, source_ref AS sourceRef, granted_amount AS grantedAmount, remaining_amount AS remainingAmount, grant_ledger_id AS grantLedgerId, effective_at AS effectiveAt, expire_at AS expireAt, status, version FROM monthly_ticket_lot WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND remaining_amount > 0 AND effective_at <= #{now} AND expire_at > #{now} ORDER BY expire_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, source_type AS sourceType, source_ref AS sourceRef, granted_amount AS grantedAmount, remaining_amount AS remainingAmount, grant_ledger_id AS grantLedgerId, effective_at AS effectiveAt, expire_at AS expireAt, status, version FROM monthly_ticket_lot WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND remaining_amount > 0 AND expire_at <= #{cutoff} ORDER BY expire_at ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, period_code AS periodCode, status, start_at AS startAt, end_at AS endAt, vote_cutoff_at AS voteCutoffAt, policy_version AS policyVersion, version FROM monthly_ticket_season WHERE id = #{seasonId} AND status = 'OPEN' AND start_at <= #{at} AND vote_cutoff_at > #{at} LIMIT 1

SELECT b.id AS bookId, b.author_id AS authorId, a.user_id AS ownerUserId, b.status, b.audit_status AS auditStatus, b.crawl_source_id AS crawlSourceId, b.crawl_book_id AS crawlBookId, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gamification_book_block gb WHERE gb.book_id = b.id AND gb.active = 1) AS blocked, (a.user_id IS NOT NULL AND a.user_id = #{userId}) AS selfOwned, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM author_book_collaborator c JOIN author ca ON ca.id = c.collaborator_author_id WHERE c.book_id = b.id AND ca.user_id IS NOT NULL AND ca.user_id = #{userId}) AS collaborator FROM book b LEFT JOIN author a ON a.id = b.author_id WHERE b.id = #{bookId} LIMIT 1

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monthly_ticket_lot_allocation (ledger_id, lot_id, amount, lot_remaining_after) VALUES (#{ledgerId}, #{lotId}, #{amount}, #{remainingAfter})

INSERT INTO monthly_ticket_vote (season_id, book_id, author_id, user_id, ticket_count, ledger_id, idempotency_key, request_hash, client_request_id, status, source_ip_hash, source_device_hash, policy_version) VALUES (#{seasonId}, #{bookId}, #{authorId}, #{userId}, #{ticketCount}, #{ledgerId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, #{clientRequestId}, 'VALID', #{sourceIpHash}, #{sourceDeviceHash}, #{policyVersion})
INSERT IGNORE INTO monthly_rank_voter (season_id, book_id, user_id) VALUES (#{seasonId}, #{bookId}, #{userId})

INSERT INTO monthly_rank_counter (season_id, book_id, total_tickets, vote_count, distinct_voter_count, last_vote_at) VALUES (#{seasonId}, #{bookId}, #{ticketCount}, 1, #{newDistinctVoter}, #{voteAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_tickets = total_tickets + VALUES(total_tickets), vote_count = vote_count + 1, distinct_voter_count = distinct_voter_count + VALUES(distinct_voter_count), last_vote_at = CASE WHEN last_vote_at IS NULL OR last_vote_at < VALUES(last_vote_at) THEN VALUES(last_vote_at) ELSE last_vote_at END, version = version + 1
mapper.select: SELECT season_id AS seasonId, book_id AS bookId, total_tickets AS totalTickets, vote_count AS voteCount, distinct_voter_count AS distinctVoterCount, version FROM monthly_rank_counter WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO scheduled_job_run (job_type, scope_type, scope_key, status, owner_instance, heartbeat_at, started_at) VALUES (#{jobType}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeKey}, 'RUNNING', #{ownerInstance}, #{startedAt}, #{startedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduled_job_run SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt = attempt + 1, owner_instance = #{ownerInstance}, heartbeat_at = #{claimedAt}, started_at = #{claimedAt}, finished_at = NULL, error_message = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE job_type = #{jobType} AND scope_type = #{scopeType} AND scope_key = #{scopeKey} AND (status = 'FAILED' OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND heartbeat_at < #{staleBefore}))
mapper.select: SELECT a.user_id, a.available_balance, COALESCE(SUM(l.remaining_amount), 0) AS lot_remaining FROM monthly_ticket_account a LEFT JOIN monthly_ticket_lot l ON l.user_id = a.user_id AND l.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE a.update_time < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) - INTERVAL 10 SECOND GROUP BY a.user_id, a.available_balance HAVING a.available_balance <> COALESCE(SUM(l.remaining_amount), 0)

SELECT g.id AS ledger_id, g.entry_type, ABS(g.amount) AS ledger_amount, COALESCE(SUM(a.amount), 0) AS allocated_amount FROM monthly_ticket_ledger g LEFT JOIN monthly_ticket_lot_allocation a ON a.ledger_id = g.id WHERE g.entry_type IN ('SPEND', 'EXPIRE', 'REVOKE') AND g.create_time < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) - INTERVAL 10 SECOND GROUP BY g.id, g.entry_type, g.amount HAVING COALESCE(SUM(a.amount), 0) <> ABS(g.amount)

SELECT l.id AS lot_id, l.user_id, l.grant_ledger_id FROM monthly_ticket_lot l LEFT JOIN monthly_ticket_ledger g ON g.id = l.grant_ledger_id WHERE l.create_time < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) - INTERVAL 10 SECOND AND (g.id IS NULL OR g.entry_type <> 'GRANT' OR g.user_id <> l.user_id)

SELECT 'STALE_JOB' AS alert_type, j.id AS scope_id, CONCAT(j.job_type, ':', j.scope_type, ':', j.scope_key) AS scope_key, j.heartbeat_at AS observed_at FROM scheduled_job_run j WHERE j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.heartbeat_at < #{jobCutoff} UNION ALL SELECT 'REVIEW_OVERDUE' AS alert_type, s.id AS scope_id, s.period_code AS scope_key, s.review_at AS observed_at FROM monthly_ticket_season s WHERE s.status = 'REVIEW' AND (s.review_at IS NULL OR s.review_at < #{reviewCutoff})

SELECT a.id AS allocation_id, a.allocation_no, a.author_id, a.amount_xu, a.posted_at FROM author_reward_allocation a WHERE a.status = 'POSTED_PENDING' AND (a.posted_at IS NULL OR a.posted_at < #{claimCutoff})

SELECT u.nick_name AS nickname, b.book_name AS bookName, v.ticket_count AS ticketCount FROM monthly_ticket_vote v JOIN gamification_profile p ON p.user_id = v.user_id AND p.ticker_opt_out = 0 JOIN user u ON u.id = v.user_id JOIN book b ON b.id = v.book_id WHERE v.status = 'VALID' ORDER BY v.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
